d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne nanv dvara ghaton par chhath puja vyavastha ka nirikshan kiya. chhath mahaparv ke tisre din sandhya arghy dene ke lie bari sankhya men shraddhalu ghaton par maujud hain.
Is dauran bihar sarkar men mantri ramkripal yadav aur bhajpa sansad ravishankar prasad bhi maujud rahe.
